shortDescription: Anthropic is considering launching a new artificial intelligence model before its initial public offering, Reuters reported. According to ChainCatcher, the company’s IPO could be delayed until after the U.S. midterm elections.

title: Anthropic Considers New AI Model Before IPO, Reuters Says
